Worth becoming a regular spot
Sep 2026 • Couples
I've been to Lounge Beach Bar five times during my stay in Da Nang and honestly, I keep coming back for a reason. It's one of those places that gets better the more you visit because you start to recognize the staff and figure out exactly when to show up for the best experience.

The location is perfect if you want to be right on the beach without feeling like you're at some overly touristy resort. It's got this relaxed but upscale vibe that works whether you're grabbing a cocktail solo at the bar or bringing friends for a proper dinner. The view of the ocean is incredible, especially once the sun starts setting. You're literally feet from the water, and there's something special about sipping a drink while watching the waves.

The live band that plays in the evenings is genuinely talented. It's not just background noise—they actually draw a crowd and set a really good atmosphere. They mix up covers with original stuff, and the energy is always solid. It's the kind of entertainment that doesn't feel forced or cheesy, which honestly says a lot about the place.

But here's the part that really impressed me: the fire shows. I didn't expect that the first time I went, and when the fire dancers came out, it was legitimately incredible. It happens several nights a week, and it's a full production with music and choreography. It adds this whole exciting element to the night that makes Lounge feel special compared to the other beach bars around here.

The food is actually really good, which matters a lot since most beach bars skimp on the kitchen. Their steaks are solid, the seafood is fresh, and the cocktails are creative without being pretentious. I've had everything from a simple beer to their house cocktails, and nothing has disappointed me yet. Prices are fair for the location and quality.

The only thing I'd mention is that service can be a bit slow when they're busy, but honestly that never bothered me much. It just gave me more time to enjoy the vibe and watch the ocean. It's not a place where you rush through dinner anyway.

If you're in Da Nang and want a night out that feels actually good, not just Instagram-worthy, Lounge Beach Bar is it. I'll definitely be back.
